entities.summary: Xonobod is a district-level city in Andijan Region, Uzbekistan. It has an area of 20 km2 (7.7 sq mi) and 44,000 inhabitants (2020). It lies to the east of Andijan in the Ferghana Valley, on the right bank of the Kara Darya.
